latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Copywriting skill — write high-converting marketing copy using proven frameworks.

- Provides step-by-step guidance for landing pages, headlines, CTAs, product descriptions, ads, email sequences, and more.
- Covers core copywriting formulas: AIDA, PAS, and FAB, with clear examples.
- Includes techniques for emotional triggers, objection handling, and trust-building with proof.
- Offers actionable headline formulas and CTA best practices.
- Designed for solopreneurs, marketers, and founders looking to drive action with persuasive writing.

raw_record.summary: Write persuasive copy for landing pages, emails, ads, sales pages, and marketing materials. Use when you need to write headlines, CTAs, product descriptions, ad copy, email sequences, or any text meant to drive action. Covers copywriting formulas (AIDA, PAS, FAB), headline writing, emotional triggers, objection handling in copy, and A/B testing. Trigger on "write copy", "copywriting", "landing page copy", "headline", "write a sales page", "ad copy", "email copy", "persuasive writing", "how to write [marketing text]".
